note: A sealed station with more domes (the moon) adds a pin for its landing bay and one per dome ('bay', 'barracks', 'homes': GlobeMap.station_pins; the barracks' says who holds it), and the globe draws the station's domes, pit and tunnels as outlines under them (GlobeMap.station_shapes). The F11 Map page (src/systems/flow/globe_map.gd, src/ui/globe_view.gd): a globe of the planet with the places that stay put, each clickable to set a waypoint the HUD's objective pointer follows. Pins come from the world's landmarks (the Remnant's outposts and the port also say who holds them: Territory; 'held' lines are their hover text, 'legend_' lines the legend's) (content/core/worlds/), the planet's native camps and the town's markers; nothing that moves is on it. 'kinds' names each landmark kind ('location' landmarks use their location file's kind); a location's own 'label' wins over the kind's, and 'labels' wins over both. 'skip' lists landmark ids left off. 'town' are the port's own stops, shown once zoomed in past 'town_zoom' (the port's pin hides then); the town's vendors (content/core/vendors/) are added to them. 'arrive' is how close (m) counts as there: the waypoint clears itself. 'off_planet' heads the list of places beside the map: the star system's chart (src/ui/system_view.gd: every planet where it really hangs, the home planet in the middle; 'system_' lines), every planet in it (this one marked 'system_here'), and the Remnant cruiser when this world has one; clicking one opens its own map (another planet's globe, or the cruiser's side view with 'cruiser_places' named), and 'back' returns to this one. The page opens on the planet you are on, and on the system's chart out in space (above the planet's space_altitude in a ship). A waypoint set on another planet points there first ('waypoint_there'). Looks: content/look/map.json.

lines.cruiser_hint: Click a room to set a waypoint. The stairs run up to the bridge.
lines.none: Click a place to set a waypoint. Drag to turn, wheel or + / - to zoom.
lines.system_hint: Click a planet to open its map. Drag to move, wheel or + / - to zoom.
lines.no_globe: No surface map here: this place is not a planet.
